# mimecast_dmarc_domain_group_association (Resource)

Associate one managed DMARC Analyzer domain with a domain group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mimecast_dmarc_domain_group_association" "example" {
  group_id  = mimecast_dmarc_domain_group.example.id
  domain_id = mimecast_dmarc_managed_domain.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) Managed-domain ID to associate.
- `group_id` (String) DMARC Analyzer domain-group ID.

### Read-Only

- `domain` (String) Associated domain hostname.
- `id` (String) Composite domain-group and managed-domain ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mimecast_dmarc_domain_group_association.example domain-group-id/managed-domain-id
```
